name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B
purpose: Vision-language model for reasoning, coding, tool use, and document and video understanding; the BF16 release is for customization and full-precision evaluation, NVFP4 for deployment.

license.name: OpenMDW-1.1
license.notes: OpenMDW-1.1 text read in the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning repo LICENSE and on openmdw.ai: 'permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to deal in the Model Materials without restriction, including under all copyright, patent, database, and trade secret rights'; conditions are only to keep the agreement and notices when distributing, and termination if you sue over patent or copyright infringement by the materials; 'no restrictions or obligations with respect to ... outputs'. This repo has no LICENSE file; the card tag names openmdw-1.1 with the same link, so the Lightning text applies.

architecture.kind: hybrid Mamba-2 + Transformer sparse MoE with C-RADIO vision encoder
architecture.why_this_design: Card: the hybrid combines Mamba-2, MoE and attention layers for long-context processing (up to 1M tokens) with sparse expert computation (512 routed experts per MoE layer); a shared MTP head predicts future tokens recursively for speculative decoding and is boosted after post-training to raise acceptance; the backbone is initialized from Nemotron 3 Super Base and distilled from Nemotron 3 Ultra Base.

pc-16gb.notes: NVFP4 about 65-70 GB estimate (120 B at about 4.5 bit); 12 B active is 4x the reference's per-token read.

pc-24gb.variant: NVFP4 about 68 GB estimate, 96 GB RAM

pc-32gb.variant: NVFP4 about 68 GB estimate, 128 GB RAM

engine_support.notes: Card names vLLM and SGLang on Hopper and Blackwell; no GGUF found.

strengths: Best vendor research numbers in this set: BrowseComp 78, GPQA 89.5, WMT24++ 84.8
weaknesses: Needs 4 H100 per the card; local use only via 4-bit and 96-128 GB RAM
best_for: Research agents on 32 GB VRAM plus 128 GB RAM

tona_fit.reason: Strong research and German numbers (preliminary independent Elo 1565, INCLUDE DE 86.9, MMLU-ProX DE 79.3), OpenMDW-1.1 (text read), 1M context, but 120B total (12B active) needs 64 GB+ unified memory or a 32 GB PC with large RAM and has no GGUF on record. Missing GGUF and nemotron_h_moe support are only blockers.
